name: Studio Ghibli API
summary: Small keyless JSON API of Studio Ghibli films, characters, locations, species and vehicles.
description: Five collections: films (22 at check, with director, producer, release year, running time, Rotten Tomatoes score, poster and banner), people (57), locations (25), species (7) and vehicles (3), cross-linked by URL. Handy as a demo dataset for REST clients and for anime film lookups.

endpoints.summary: Characters with films and species links

license.name: Not stated for the data (the source repository is MIT licensed)

agent_notes: Fetch the collection endpoints once and cache; the data is tiny and static. Numeric values (release_date, running_time, rt_score) are strings. Cross references are full URLs, so follow them or take the id from the last path segment. limit and fields (comma-separated) work on collections.
caveats: The original project was archived on 2022-12-01 after Heroku ended its free tier; this Vercel deployment is a community-hosted continuation whose operator is not documented, so treat it as unstable.
The data license was not found; film posters link to TMDB images.
A film's locations array can contain a bare collection URL ("/locations/") instead of an id.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without credentials; swagger.yaml returned a Swagger 2.0 document.
